title: Biomaterials for intervertebral disc regeneration: Niche reprogramming, precision therapeutics, and structural reconstruction

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Biomaterials for intervertebral disc regeneration: Niche reprogramming, precision therapeutics, and structural reconstruction》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) arises from coupled redox imbalance, inflammation, cellular senescence, nutrient limitation, matrix loss, and mechanical failure.

evidence.text: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) arises from coupled redox imbalance, inflammation, cellular senescence, nutrient limitation, matrix loss, and mechanical failure.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Biomaterials for intervertebral disc regeneration: Niche reprogramming, precision therapeutics, and structural reconstruction》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】Durable regeneration will likely require coordinated control of the pathological niche, patient selection, and compartment-specific mechanics rather than a single universal material.

evidence.text: Durable regeneration will likely require coordinated control of the pathological niche, patient selection, and compartment-specific mechanics rather than a single universal material.
